module_summary: Two-state Moore FSM (Lemmings): a 1-bit direction register toggles on bump inputs and decodes walk_left/walk_right outputs.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Walk-direction state register, async reset to left, toggled by bump inputs.

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from state WL indicating leftward walking.

anchors.name: walk_right
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from state WR indicating rightward walking.

groups.name: direction_fsm
groups.description: Direction state register, bump-driven next-state logic and walk output decode.
